title: Create the enrichment orchestration module seam and shared helper contract
acceptance_criteria: A dedicated orchestration module scaffold exists for the enrichment metadata slice without pulling in HLTB, family, or final output logic.
The new seam uses explicit inputs/dependencies for cache policy, fetchers, persistence, and progress reporting.
steam_deals_generator.py keeps a compatibility-friendly import/wrapper boundary ready for the extracted orchestration helpers.
completion_summary: Se creo el seam de orquestacion de enrichment y boundary compatible en el generator.
